s: July 3, 2024 - In fact, Evans noted, "many women take tamoxifen 20 mg for 5 years with no side effects." Overall, "I don't think we've got the evidence yet to drop" dosages, particularly in women without high-risk lesions, Evans said. A real concern, he added, is poor metabolizers for whom 5 mg won't be enough to have a preventive effect. De Censi noted, however, that there will likely never be a definitive answer to the question of baby TAM vs standard dosing because industry has no financial incentive to do a head-to-head trial because tamoxifen went off patent over 30 years ago.
